Game

TriviSpar

Purpose

TriviSpar is a player-made trivia game: write a question for your opponent, they answer against a 20-second clock, and the AI referee holds the answer key and grades it fairly. Play 1v1 or party up to 16 players — in the same room or turn-by-turn from anywhere.

Development stage

In development.

← Back to portfolio
Social

BondFyres

Purpose

A 21+ social app for meeting people in small live video sessions of up to four, matched on what you actually have in common. Come for friendship, business, or dating. The connection is up to you.

Development stage

In development.

YouTube

Vibe Shop Class

Purpose

A YouTube channel that teaches anyone to build real things with AI: websites, apps, stores, even books. Short episodes, one build at a time, no jargon. Claude does the heavy lifting. The ideas are yours.

Quality Stoner

Purpose

Fiction

The Unmirrored

The story

Ten years after an online war over AI, everyone gets paid, as long as they stay mirrored. When a Watcher sworn to protect the world from the machines is found dead, one man starts asking who is really watching whom.

A literary thriller by J. Simmons.
